title: 자기소개 질문: 누구, 뭐, 어디, 언제, 왜?
objective: By the end, you can choose the right question word (누구, 뭐, 어디, 언제, 왜, 어떻게, 얼마, 몇, 어느, 무슨) and use it in a short question when you meet someone new.
summary: Learn ten Korean question words that you need to ask and answer simple questions when you meet new people.

task.title: Choose the question word
task.line: Read each short question and its answer, then write the question word from the choices that fits the blank.

words.exampleMeaning: Who is this person? (looking at a photo)

words.meaning: what (뭐 in speech, 무엇 in writing)

words.exampleMeaning: When did you come to Korea?

words.meaning: how many, what number (comes before a counter such as 살, 명)

words.exampleMeaning: What kind of work do you do?

exercises: Choose 어디 or 언제 for each blank: ① A: 생일이 ____예요? B: 5월 3일이에요. ② A: 화장실이 ____예요? B: 저쪽이에요.
Choose 뭐 or 몇 for each blank: ① A: 주말에 ____ 해요? B: 친구를 만나요. ② A: 가족이 ____ 명이에요? B: 네 명이에요.
Choose 어떻게 or 왜 for each blank: ① A: 학교에 ____ 와요? B: 지하철로 와요. ② A: ____ 회사에 안 가요? B: 아파요.
Choose 누구 or 얼마 for each blank: ① A: ____랑 살아요? B: 친구랑 살아요. ② A: 모두 ____예요? B: 만 이천 원이에요.
Choose 어느 or 무슨 for each blank: ① A: ____ 음식을 좋아해요? B: 한국 음식을 좋아해요. ② A: 커피하고 차, ____ 게 좋아요? B: 차가 좋아요.
